href.note: renders a native <a> with identical chrome; type is then ignored

a11y.semanticStructure: Native <button type> or native <a href> when href is set; link semantics kept deliberately (Enter activates, Space scrolls). No ARIA overrides; uppercase is CSS text-transform, AT reads the author's casing.
a11y.keyboard: Native activation, no custom key handling; focus ring only on :focus-visible — 2px accent outline, 3px offset, both variants.
a11y.decisions: Corner brackets and hover glow are decorative pseudo-elements/box-shadow, invisible to AT. Disabled is out of v1 by arbitration (RFC §7). Contrast is computed by the gate from resolved tokens, never declared here.
a11y.notes: Implemented per RFC §4; this status moves to pass only through the accessibility engine gate, never by assertion.
